model_output.verdict: An executive marketing resume that connects leadership, budgets and campaigns to substantial business results.
write_up: This is a strong executive marketing resume! Your path from Senior Marketing Manager to Chief Marketing Officer is easy to follow, and your Novara work connects a 45-person organization and $25M budget to growth, launches and acquisition costs.

The customer advocacy line at Viridian is a good model: it names the program you led and ties it to retention and upsell revenue. Experience leads the resume, and the team and budget figures make your executive remit easy to find.

Tighten the few measures that aren't defined, and make the P&L claim as precise as the budget claim. Your resume isn't likely to be the thing holding you back; the competitiveness of a particular executive opening will also matter.

cards.line: - I decided to establish a quarterly business review process with sales and product leadership that improved campaign alignment and delivered a 15% increase in channel sales effectiveness.
cards.cannot_tell: The review process is clear, but a recruiter can't tell what the 15% increase in channel sales effectiveness measures. Name the measure so they know what changed.
cards.example: I decided to establish a quarterly business review process with sales and product leadership that improved campaign alignment and delivered a 15% increase in channel sales effectiveness, measured by [measure].
cards.question: What measure showed the 15% increase in channel sales effectiveness?

cards.line: - I partnered with sales and channel teams to develop sales enablement tools, increasing sales productivity by 15%.
cards.cannot_tell: The partnership and tools are clear, but sales productivity can mean several things. The measure behind the 15% would show what improved.
cards.example: I partnered with sales and channel teams to develop sales enablement tools, increasing sales productivity by 15%, measured by [measure].
cards.question: What measure showed the 15% increase in sales productivity?

cards.line: - Budget & P&L Management ($25M+)
cards.cannot_tell: Your Novara role names a $25M annual budget, but it doesn't explain what P&L responsibility you held. Those are different kinds of ownership at executive level.
cards.example: Budget Management ($25M annual budget); P&L Management ([what you owned])
cards.question: What P&L responsibility did you hold, if any?

cards.line: - I led the development and launch of a new customer advocacy program that increased customer retention by 12% and generated $4M in upsell revenue within 18 months.
cards.cannot_tell: Keep this as a model. It gives the program a name, makes your leadership clear and puts a timeframe on the revenue figure.

cards.line: - I led a 45-person global marketing organization managing a $25M annual budget, driving company-wide brand and demand generation strategy for a SaaS platform serving 2M+ users across 40 countries.
cards.cannot_tell: For a move beyond the marketing function, your part in a company-wide decision would show how your leadership reaches across the business.
cards.example: I led a 45-person global marketing organization managing a $25M annual budget and [your contribution to a company-wide decision].
cards.question: What company-wide decision beyond marketing did you contribute to, and what was your part?

cards.line: - Executive Stakeholder Engagement and Communication
cards.cannot_tell: You can cut this general skill if you need room. Your work with sales and product leadership already shows it in practice.

fit.why: Your current Chief Marketing Officer role leads a global marketing organization, and your earlier roles show a progression through marketing leadership.
fit.level: executive, leads a 45-person global marketing organization with a $25M annual budget
fit.note: Your experience points toward senior marketing leadership in SaaS and other technology businesses. Keep the strongest business results and the team and budget figures prominent.
